question:
Identify the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word in brackets.
The teacher commended the student for his (diligent) efforts.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Lazy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"diligent"** means someone who shows care and conscientiousness in their work or duties; being hardworking. (परिश्रमी)
 
 
• **Example:** The diligent student completed all assignments on time and with great attention to detail.
 
 
 
• **"Lazy"** refers to someone unwilling to work or use energy; it is the opposite of diligent. (आलसी)
 
 
• **Example:** He was too lazy to complete his homework, so he procrastinated the entire day.
